item.title: Version 0.8
item.description:
Two new cats, and your forgotten installers

If you've switched on I have a cat, two new moods can turn up now.

  • The Saboteur crouches next to a file the robot is heading for, waits, and swipes it out of the way at the last second. Then it looks at the robot like nothing happened. The file still gets cleaned up in the end. The robot just has to go back for it.
  • The Coward takes one look at the robot and bolts. It hides under one of your windows, or just off the edge of the screen, and peeks out when the robot is far enough away. Move the window and it'll find somewhere else.

That makes six cats. I still don't know which one is my favourite.

Disk images get ejected

That installer you opened last month is probably still mounted on your desktop. Trash and Delete now eject read-only disk images at the very end, along with everything else. They're listed on the final screen, so you can untick any you want to keep, and Undo mounts them again. Anything writable or in use is left alone. Thanks to santahate for the idea on GitHub.

RoboDust also won't move or delete a disk image file while its disk is still mounted, which it could do before.

Raufan
